observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Grand staircase of the Palais Garnier, Paris, during a formal ball.
observation.formation_and_space: Couples are arranged in a long, double-file line, moving in a procession down the stairs and onto the floor.
observation.footwork: Walking steps, precise and rhythmic, matching the beat of the music. The low resolution makes it difficult to see the exact footwork.
observation.arms_and_hands: Partners hold hands, with arms held in a formal, slightly elevated position. Some dancers hold their partner's hand while the other hand is at their side or holding their dress.
observation.hips_and_torso: Still and upright, maintaining a formal posture.
observation.partnering: Couples hold hands, with a clear lead-and-follow dynamic as they move in unison.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: No jumps or floor work; the movement is primarily walking and turning.
observation.costume_and_props: Men wear formal military-style uniforms with gold buttons and white gloves. Women wear long, elegant red evening gowns with black gloves.
observation.cannot_infer: The low resolution and camera angles make it difficult to see the exact footwork and weight transfer.

signature_moments.what: The procession of couples walking down the grand staircase in a synchronized, formal manner.
Couples walking in a line, maintaining a consistent, elegant pace.
Couples turning and interacting with their partners while maintaining the line formation.
Couples performing a synchronized turn while moving in the procession.
